processing.bands: Source true-colour image: B04 (red), B03 (green), B02 (blue), producer-rendered uint8, not raw reflectance
processing.resampling: Bilinear sampling from first TCI COG overview (~20m); nearest-neighbour SCL; Lanczos mobile downsample
processing.projection: No reprojection: both source tiles and output are EPSG:32643. Geographic overlays transformed from CRS84 using pyproj always_xy=True. North-up metric grid with square ground pixels (rounded output width).
processing.color: Source RGB retained separately; candidate: common gamma 1/1.05, Pillow contrast 1.04 then colour 1.03. No sharpening, compositional edits or AI.
processing.seam: 43QBB priority; same-datatake 43QBA fills only south strip below north tile footprint
